name: Phantom Thirst
source:
Having barely escaped death, you were found by four strangers. A bond and a curse unite you, where desire and peril collide. Will you fall for them... or lose your soul?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
死里逃生的你被四个陌生人发现。羁绊与诅咒将你们团结在一起，欲望与危险发生碰撞。你会爱上他们……还是失去灵魂？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
